## Credits and License

**This is a remix, not my design.** The shelf is generated by **[mitufy](https://github.com/mitufy)**'s [openConnect Sturdy Shelf Generator](https://makerworld.com/en/models/2257523-openconnect-sturdy-shelf-generator) — the geometry, the truss, the texture and the printed-on-its-side idea are all mitufy's work. What I contributed is one configuration of it, sized around a document scanner, split into two printable halves and laid out on plates. That seemed worth sharing; the design credit is not mine.

mitufy's shelf generator is licensed **CC BY-SA 4.0**, so this listing is **CC BY-SA 4.0** as well — ShareAlike carries over to anything derived from it. If you remix this in turn, it stays under the same license.

Also credited as remixed sources on this listing:

- **[openConnect](https://makerworld.com/en/models/2257440-openconnect-opengrid-s-own-connector-system)** by **mitufy** — the connector system the mount uses, licensed CC BY 4.0. The snaps and screws on plate 3 come from here.
- **[openGrid](https://makerworld.com/en/models/1179191-opengrid-wall-desk-mounting-framework-ecosystem)** by **David D** — the 28mm modular grid this hangs on.

The generator's source is at [github.com/mitufy/opengrid-projects](https://github.com/mitufy/opengrid-projects) if you would rather build your own configuration than use this one.
